## EcrecoverRatifierUtils.ratify() function

Signs or consumes a tree signature and returns payload-ready items.

Use after `Tree.mempoolValidate` and before `Payload.encode`<!-- -->. The returned items preserve tree leaf order and include ratifier data required by takers. The group id is stored on each inline offer.

**Signature:**

```typescript
function ratify(params: EcrecoverRatifierRatifyParams): Promise<readonly Payload.Item[]>;
```

**Returns:**

Promise&lt;readonly [Payload.Item](./midnight-sdk.payload.item.md)<!-- -->\[\]&gt;

Items containing each offer and its ratifier data.

## Exceptions

`InvalidTreeError` when the tree is invalid or contains multiple ratifiers.

`InvalidTreeHeightError` when the tree height is unsupported.

`InvalidTypedDataSignatureError` when client signing or a precomputed signature does not recover to `params.account`<!-- -->.

## Remarks

Parameter details:

- `params.tree`<!-- -->: Ecrecover-ratified offer tree-like input to ratify.

- `params.client`<!-- -->: Optional viem client whose transport signs typed data built from `params.tree`<!-- -->.

- `params.account`<!-- -->: Optional account used to sign typed data built from `params.tree`<!-- -->.

- `params.signature`<!-- -->: Optional precomputed signature for `params.tree`<!-- -->.

## Example


```ts
import { EcrecoverRatifierUtils, Tree } from "@morpho-org/midnight-sdk";
import { Offer } from "@morpho-org/midnight-sdk";
import { createWalletClient, http, zeroAddress } from "viem";
import { base } from "viem/chains";

const offer = Offer.create({
  market: {
    chainId: 8453,
    midnight: "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000001000",
    loanToken: "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000006000",
    collateralParams: [
      {
        token: "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000007000",
        lltv: 770000000000000000n,
        liquidationCursor: 250000000000000000n,
        oracle: "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000008000",
      },
    ],
    maturity: 54_000n,
    rcfThreshold: 0n,
    enterGate: zeroAddress,
    liquidatorGate: zeroAddress,
  },
  buy: true,
  maker: "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000009000",
  tick: 5_000n,
  expiry: 3_600n,
  ratifier: "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000004000",
  maxUnits: 100n,
});
const client = createWalletClient({
  chain: base,
  transport: http(),
});

const items = await EcrecoverRatifierUtils.ratify({
  tree: Tree.create([offer]),
  client,
  account: offer.maker,
});
console.log(items.length);
```
